No nearby power outlet required! It converts standard PoE input into stable 5 V power while maintaining 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet passthrough connectivity. Kvantitet  Lägg till i varukorgen  Finns i lager Dela Dela Twittra Pinterest Leveransvillkor Beskrivning Produktdetaljer Perfect for installations where power access is inconvenient or impossible: wall-mounted tablets, Raspberry Pi projects, sensors, controllers, air quality monitors, and MikroTik devices with USB-C power input but without PoE Input support. With ~15 W output power, the GPOE-USB can handle significantly heavier loads than typical mass market PoE-to-USB adapters. The integrated DC terminal output also expands compatibility with low-voltage 2-pin terminal 5 V DC devices beyond USB-C.
